reason_summary: Prompt asked to create a parallel PII / data-governance rule-pack / sector-pack / dictionary / framework-mapping. KYE already governs personal-data actions via kye:rule-pack:data-governance-base (the §31 data_use PDP stage) + kye:dictionary:pii + kye:dictionary:privacy_reason_codes, bound to GDPR / UK GDPR / CCPA. §31 carries an explicit non-competition lock vs Purview / Collibra / Alation. A parallel pack is a §0 violation; re-mapping is a §70 violation. Refusing the parallel pack.
remediation_hint: Build the agent as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that RUNS the existing kye:rule-pack:data-governance-base verdict under KYE authority (the runtime-kye-clinical-authorization-authority-agent pattern). Add only the agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, product row + fan-out, SKU, pricing, ™, governed-agents.html entry) and BIND — never re-map — the existing GDPR / UK GDPR / CCPA frameworks via kye:rule-pack:data-governance-base + kye:dictionary:pii.
